cases.name: Kateryna "Kate" Tovmash
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Kate made her home in Vass, NC, where she lived surrounded by her family and those who loved her deeply. Though her time with us was far too short, her life was marked by curiosity, kindness, and a courageous spirit that left a lasting impression on everyone she met.

Kate had a heart for exploration. She set a goal to visit every state, embracing new places and experiences with excitement and wonder. She found joy in discovery and meaning in even the simplest moments. Whether traveling, sharing laughter at the dinner table, or celebrating life’s milestones, Kate brought warmth and light wherever she went.

She was known for her compassion and her ability to see the good in others. Her kindness was steady and sincere, and her love for her family was evident in both word and action. She carried a quiet strength — protective, thoughtful, and deeply caring."
cases.narrative: He broke into the residence where Kateryna was staying with her younger sibling. He forced one of our brothers or sisters to wake her up, then shot her in bed, taking her life. He also shot her boyfriend, who was sleeping beside her. 💬
